description: Figure 8, titled "Different Audio-Language models’ performance on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR," is a bar chart that compares the performance of various audio-language models on two different benchmarks. The horizontal axis lists the different models, including CLIP, Wav2CLIP, AudioCLIP, and others. The vertical axis represents the performance score, with values ranging from 0 to 100. Each model has two bars, one for the MMAU (test-mini) benchmark and one for the MMAR benchmark, allowing for a direct comparison of their performance on each task. The chart shows that the models exhibit varying levels of performance, with some models performing better on MMAU and others on MMAR, highlighting the differences in their capabilities across these two evaluation metrics.
